entries.heading: Deckerville Eagles
entries.narrative: - Kim - She joined the league in 2024. She claimed the league was easy and once again a "Terry" team dominated the league, right up until the Cathedral Bowl and then fell apart. Season 2 wasn't as easy, missing the playoffs dispite have the leage MVP RB Christian McCaffrey and OROY RB Ashton Jeanty. The team moved up to 26th overall in wins.

entries.heading: West Catholic Burrs
entries.narrative: - John - from Philly. He joined in 2023 and was really quiet his first season in the league but took the team to the Championship. He took over a great team and we look forward to seeing what he does with it in the coming seasons. And just like that, a one and done owner.

entries.heading: *Cathedral Golden Gales
entries.narrative:
- Terry - from Canada. Elite owner from the beginning. We had to pause the initial draft for a couple days as Terry went missing with a heart attack. Vincennes had mentioned that Terry wasn't feeling well and was going to the hospital. I took a chance of finding his status by calling a local hospital and asking if he was there. They said yes and asked who I was. I responded by saying that I was a friend at his Alma Mater. They let me know how he was doing and transferred my phone call to him.
​One of the toughest competitors in the league. Always posting something on the message board and adding value to the league. Terry has won the league 4 times and has been to the Championship game 8 times in 16 seasons and 11 times in the post season. While only winning his division twice. When you play him, you will have your hands full. Awards? Yeah. 3 MVPs in Season 1, 8, & 9(LaDainian Tomlinson, 2 for Peyton Manning), 1 Offensive Rookie in Season 4 (Percy Harvin), 1 Defensive Rookie in Season 9 (CJ Mosley), and 3 Manager of the Year in Season 8 & 12.
